newsitem.title: MEXICO: Costa Rica revokes Tribasa concession.
newsitem.headline: Costa Rica revokes Tribasa concession.

text.p: The Costa Rican government has revoked the highway concession it had granted Mexican builder Grupo Tribasa and its Costa Rican partners, a Tribasa spokesman, Jorge Coo, said Monday.
Tribasa won the concession in 1996 for the $15 million renovation of 41 km (25 miles) of highway.
"(The concession) is now annuled, there's nothing we can do. We don't want to get ourselves into an internal problem in Costa Rica," Coo said.
Coo said the concession was withdrawn because the Costa Rican Comptroller's office determined that the Public Works Ministry that gave the concession did not have the legal right to do so.

Although Tribasa had not begun work on the highway, he said the company will call for the reimbursement for some expenses incurred in studying the construction. Tribasa's Costa Rican partners were studying the possibility of suing the government, he added.
